After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] armed himself with a small set of weapons. Among them was a '''duracris [[poniard]]'''<ref name="CNI:JT" /> which he kept in the same sheath between his shoulder blades as his [[Jax Pavan's vibroknife|vibroknife]], though the poniard was completely concealed in the sheath.<ref name="Sheath">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]'' states that the duracris [[poniard]] is kept in a sheath between his shoulder blades. However, later in the book when facing the [[feral droid]]s and [[10-4TO]] Jax pulls his [[Jax Pavan's vibroknife|vibroknife]] from a sheath between his shoulder blades. There is no indication that there are two sheaths so it must be the same one. Additionally, the vibroknife is stated to be the only visible weapon he has on his person, meaning the poniard must be completely inside the sheath.</ref> Jax used a small [[confounder unit]] in the same pocket as his [[Jax Pavan's lightsaber|lightsaber]] to stop the poniard from appearing on routine scans.<ref name="CNI:JT" /> Following the [[Ambush near the Twins|ambush]] near the [[Twins (star system)/Legends|Twins]], Jax Pavan escaped the crashing [[Far Ranger]] with only his [[Jax Pavan's third lightsaber|third lightsaber]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] old [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]], his [[Miisai|miisai tree]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith holocron/Legends|holocron]] [[SD41263.I]].<ref name="Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
